## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (locale check, build, all tests)
- [ ] A test fails without this change (or the change is only texts / docs)
- [ ] It still **fails open**: anything unexpected leaves X working as if the extension were absent
- [ ] No new permission, network access or remote code (or `PRIVACY.md`, the build check and the store texts are updated)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for it
- [ ] Translations: I am a native speaker of the language I changed / I am not
